title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-mbm7: lichen-schc fragment.rs missing required constants (TILE_SIZE, WINDOW_SIZE, BITMAP_MASK, MAX_PACKET_SIZE, RULE_ID_A_TO_B, RULE_ID_B_TO_A)
description:
## Issue

`rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs` references six constants that are not defined anywhere in the crate:
- `TILE_SIZE` — used for tile/fragment sizing
- `WINDOW_SIZE` — used for window calculations
- `BITMAP_MASK` — used for bitmap operations
- `MAX_PACKET_SIZE` — used for receiver limit validation
- `RULE_ID_A_TO_B`, `RULE_ID_B_TO_A` — used for rule ID validation in `check_rule()`

The file defines `DEFAULT_WINDOW_SIZE` and `MAX_WINDOW_SIZE` but not the constants above.

## Severity

P0 — `cargo build -p lichen-schc --lib` produces 54 errors. The crate is uncompilable.

## Notes

This is pre-existing (not introduced by worker6-mbm7 commit). The constants were referenced but never defined when `fragment.rs` was created. Likely they were intended to live in `context.rs`, `rules.rs`, or a `constants.rs` module.
